scenario: Maria has a closed HMO with no out-of-network benefits. She electively visited Dr. Lee, an out-of-network dermatologist, for a routine mole check. The visit was billed at $220. The visit was not an emergency.
policy: A patient is financially responsible for the full charge of any service rendered by an out-of-network provider when the plan is a closed HMO that provides no out-of-network benefits, unless the service was a verified emergency.
question: What amount is Maria financially responsible for?
